name: jiourja-commercial
description: FACTORY KA ASLI MAALIK! — 60s 2D cartoon TV commercial for JioUrja 2.0 (Remotion + SVG rigs)

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Commercial out/commercial_raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/commercial_raw.mp4 out/JioUrja2_Factory_Ka_Asli_Maalik_1080p.mp4
scripts.qa:sync: remotion render src/index.ts DialogueStem out/dialogue.wav --codec=wav && tsx scripts/qa-sync.tsx out/dialogue.wav
scripts.render:en: remotion render src/index.ts CommercialEN out/commercial_en_raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/commercial_en_raw.mp4 out/JioUrja2_Factory_Ka_Asli_Maalik_1080p_EN-subs.mp4
scripts.render:film: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/film_raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/film_raw.mp4 out/JioUrja2_Film_with_Intro_1080p.mp4
scripts.render:film:en: remotion render src/index.ts FilmEN out/film_en_raw.mp4 && bash scripts/master.sh out/film_en_raw.mp4 out/JioUrja2_Film_with_Intro_1080p_EN-subs.mp4
